symptom: xpath_expressions.ComponentId for page and snippet data sources held `{0 [57 221 206 …]}` instead of a GUID, and no column named the widget the XPath belongs to (ComponentName is the source's $Type), so lint rule SEC011 could name a widget only when the page had one data widget over that entity.
cause: scanBSONForXPath formatted the decoded $ID with extractBsonIDString, whose default case is fmt.Sprintf("%v", id); a decoded $ID is a bson.Binary, which no case matched.
insight: A catalog package with one id formatter per builder drifts: extractBsonID, extractBinaryID and extractBsonIDString coexisted, and only the last had no bson.Binary case. Assert ids in a builder test against the formatter the joined table uses, not a hand-written string, or the test proves the format and not the join. Measured join after the fix: 6/6 on a probe app, 56/61 on FactoryManagement; the 5 misses are widgets the widgets table never indexes (MxModelReflection combo boxes), a separate gap.
